During the [[Zaarin insurrection]], loyalist [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces '''evacuated''' the [[XQ6 Platform]] ''[[Research]]'' and [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin's]] forces recaptured it.

==Prelude==
After [[Defense of Research|repelling]], at significant cost, [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin's]] previous attack on his [[Research]] platform. Loyalist [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces, knowing that Zaarin would still not give in, were compelled to evacuate the facility. To that end, the Empire assigned [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighter]] ''[[Mharsup]]'' to pick up the two remaining [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]] prototypes, [[Proto 11]] and [[Proto 12]], while [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda-class T-4a shuttle]] ''[[G'nabgib]]'' was assigned to evacuate the [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] and [[Technician/Legends|technicians]], one of whom happened to be the [[Unidentified TIE Defender chief scientist|chief scientist]] of the project.

==The battle==
[[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] left the Research platform just as ''Mharsup'' arrived with two [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|Escort shuttles]] [[Dragonfly]]. Shortly afterwards, six [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] [[Z-Mu Squadron|Z-Mu]] arrived to disrupt operations, but Stele with the help of the Escort Shuttles fended them off. However, instead of a [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B frigate]], as his briefing officer suggested, the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial-class Star Destroy]] ''[[Glory]]'' arrived launching six [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|Stormtrooper transports]] [[Z-Sigma group (Delta-class)|Z-Sigma]], some [[Utility Tug/Legends|Utility Tug]]s [[20f16]], [[TIE/Advanced starfighter|TIE Advanced]] and [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE Bombers]] that were modified to have [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]]. Despite being outnumbered, Stele held off Zaarin's fighters long enough for both the ''Mharsup'' and ''G'nabgib'' to escape into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. With both ships in hyperspace, Stele disengaged and headed for the rendezvous point, encouraged by Zaarin's own TIE Defenders. The ''Glory'' likely destroyed the ''Research'' platform.

==Aftermath==
Both ships arrived at [[Navigation buoy/Legends|Navigation buoy]] [[B-0F9]] to arrange a secret transfer to [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|Modified corvette]] group [[Hashim group|Hashim]]. This transfer area would encounter [[Second battle of Parmel|difficulties]].

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was first featured in the [[1994]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']], in which players fly as Maarek Stele. The battle is depicted in the mission "Protect Evacuation," the third mission of the game's ninth tour of campaign, "[[T/D Technology]]."

This article assumes completion of all "Primary" objectives as well as significant "Bonus" objectives which are the destruction of all Assault Gunboats, Transports, tugs, and inflicting many starfighter casualties, including at least one TIE Defender kill on both groups.
